messages.subject: Negative-valued means for Poisson model
parts:
Good day,

I tried fitting a Poisson model in INLA using only response and intercept by setting the family = "poisson" argument. The model however returns a negative-valued mean for the fixed effect. I've tried playing around with some arguments to no avail. Am I doing something wrong or misinterpreting the mean of the fixed effects as the lambda value of the link function?

Regards,
Divan
